notes: Random current object (height around -3000 or wide, mode 9 with submode 3 or random, small grid row index, minimum pitch), grid row secondary word equal or unequal to the selector at 0x1f71c8, bearing below or above 1, target and ground heights around the branch thresholds, lift scaled so the bank ratio lands inside or outside [-1, 1], and five random stack doubles. The real wrap, atan2, abs, acos and sin helpers run; stubs at 0x6e8d8 and 0x6eaf4 log their stack double, and the 0x82478 stub logs AX and its depth and returns a per-case constant in ST0.
